# Totally Normal Article About Cooking

Pasta is best cooked al dente in salted water. Reserve some pasta water to bind
the sauce; its starch is what makes a silky emulsion possible.

## Cooking tips

Butter adds richness to most sauces, and fresh herbs should go in at the end so
their aroma survives. Acid — lemon juice or vinegar — balances fat and salt.
